key_findings.title: 12 dispatcher actions MISSING across 37 MS0 units — 32% coverage gap

Missing breakdown: LATHE(2: chip_control_validate, cost_optimize), WEDM(2: troubleshoot, controller_select), CAD/SFC(1: viewer_load_stl), ADMIN(3: seat_assign, api_key_create, rbac_role_create/assign), LEARN(3: tutor_session_start, video_session_start, blueprint_trainer_quiz), plus subscription_tier_set borderline EXISTS-via-portal.

key_findings.title: NO new dispatcher needed — all 12 MISSING actions fit existing dispatchers (prism_auth, prism_tenant, prism_cam, prism_calc, prism_edm, prism_cad, prism_intelligence, prism_business)

key_findings.evidence: Grep against all dispatchers for tutor_/tutorial_/learn_/onboard_/trial_ returns ZERO. LEARN cohort is the most under-built MS0 group; per spec line 363 it 'reduces churn, increases trial→paid' — highest-leverage revenue effect blocked by zero backend.

key_findings.title: Net-new engine count for MS0 = 9 (vs spec assumption of zero net-new in MS0)
key_findings.evidence: MS0 spec frames cohort as 'wire existing engines to UI'. This synthesis identifies 9 NEW engines required (ChipControlEngine surface, LatheCostOptimizationEngine, WEDMControllerDialectEngine, CADViewerStreamEngine, ApiKeyEngine, RBACEngine, TutorialProgressionEngine, VideoTrainingEngine, BlueprintTrainingEngine) plus 1 MS1-dep (SeatAllocationEngine) and 1 wire-conflict (SubscriptionTierEngine). Spec timeline assumes wiring-only effort.
